sections.title: From ODEs to PDEs: The Leap in Complexity
lecture_lines: ODEs depend on a single variable, like time.
PDEs involve multiple variables, like space and time.
Variables interact across a multi-dimensional field.
animations: Display ODE dy/dt = f(t, y) in white. Change color to #FF5733. Display [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/clock.svg] to represent the time variable.
Display PDE ∂u/∂t = ∇²u in white. Change color to #33FF57.
Highlight interaction between space and time variables using arrows in #3357FF, incorporating [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/globe.svg] to visualize the spatial domain.

sections.title: Core Concept: The Heat Equation
lecture_lines: The heat equation is a fundamental PDE.
Time changes equal the Laplacian of space.
Curvature drives heat redistribution across the plate.
Temperature flows to reach thermal equilibrium.
animations: Display u_t = α * ∇²u in white. Change to #FF5733.
Visualize 2D heat distribution on a grid [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/plate.svg]. Change color to #33FF57.
Animate Laplacian operation showing divergence in #3357FF.
Highlight curvature using contour lines in #FF5733.
Represent thermal equilibrium with uniform color #33FF57 on the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/plate.svg].

sections.title: Boundary and Initial Conditions: The 'Rules of the Game'
lecture_lines: PDEs require constraints to provide solutions.
Boundary conditions define the physical limits.
Fixed guitar string endpoints represent Dirichlet conditions.
animations: Show physical boundary setup for the string [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/guitar.svg]. Color boundary #FFFFFF.
Display Dirichlet condition u=0. Flash label #FF5733.
Show vibration pattern for string [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/guitar.svg]. Change color #33FF57.

sections.title: The Big Picture: Why We Solve Them
lecture_lines: PDEs describe the fundamental language of nature.
Simulate airflow for efficient airplane design.
Predict weather and analyze complex signals.
